meaning.en: A woman regarded as daring or fierce.
meaning.vi: Một người phụ nữ được coi là táo bạo hoặc dữ dội.

meaning.en: A woman thought of as like a tiger in ferocity, sensuous sleekness, etc.
meaning.vi: Một người phụ nữ được ví như một con hổ trong sự hung dữ, bóng bẩy gợi cảm, v.v.
Một con hổ cái; một cô hổ.

meaning_vi: (nghĩa bóng) người đàn bà dữ tợn, sư tử cái, sư tử Hà đông

sentences.en: The tigress gives birth to from two to five, even six cubs; but three is a frequent number.

sentences.en: The Tigress one-piece is available in a typical leopard print fabric and color as well as an aqua and blushing pink option.

sentences.en: She continued her acting, doing a voiceover of Master Tigress in the Brazilian release of Kung Fu Panda.

sentences.en: The erotic pieces will make you feel like a tigress all day long, but you won't embarrass yourself or your roommate by being a bit too va-va-voom for a dorm room.

sentences.en: Fantasy Lingerie will help you get in touch with your wild side, thanks to their Wild Instincts and Tigress chemises.

sentences.en: A red strapless bra will really bring out the tigress within.

sentences.en: At the risk of being historically offensive, a fearsome tigress and a quiet flirt.

sentences.en: The wounded tigress was now roaring double tides.

sentences.en: Jean can be a real tigress if she feels criticised.
